messages:
Ava: FYI I can repro a visual leak in QuickEdit when rapidly switching orgs. The modal briefly shows rows from the previous org for ~1-3s before settling. Steps below.
Sam: steps pls
Ava: 1) be in org-A, 2) switch to org-B quickly, 3) open QuickEdit on a row in org-A view -> modal flashes rows belonging to org-B, then refreshes to org-A.
Priya: that smells like a state-init race between router params and a global store snapshot.
Jon: probable cause: QuickEdit hydrator reads sidecar cache (lastSelectedOrg) on mount while router is still reconciling, so initial render uses stale org.
Ava: example logs: `GET /api/rows?org=org-A 200 40ms` then `modal.init orgId=org-B` then UI renders rows from org-B then flips.
Maya: do we have any code that seeds modal state from global store without validating route param?
Sam: yes — QuickEditModal.tsx uses `const { lastSelectedOrg } = useAppStore()` and sets local org once on mount.
Ava: snippet I found:```// QuickEditModal.tsx
const { lastSelectedOrg } = useAppStore();
useEffect(() => { setLocal({ orgId: lastSelectedOrg }); }, []);```
Priya: empty deps array + global source = stale value. Should prefer `router.query.org` and only fallback to store.
Jon: extra wrinkle: our region-fallback logic can flip `x-org-id` headers mid-retry, so backend and UI can momentarily disagree. Worth adding a server-side sanity check too.
Sam: proposed fixes: 1) initialize modal from `router.query.org || lastSelectedOrg`, 2) clear local rows buffer before fetch (set to []), 3) emit telemetry event `quickedit.org_mismatch` when init org != router org. Rollout behind FF `quickedit-clear-init`.
Maya: add a flaky integration test that simulates rapid org swap + open. We've been missing these in CI.
Ava: privacy impact? So far only a UI flash, no writes. But even a preview of another org's rows is a P2 privacy issue. Legal/ops should see a note.
Priya: agree classify as P2 until we confirm no backend leakage. @security ping for quick review.
telemetry-bot: hooking metric `console.quickedit.org_mismatch.rate`. Will alert #incidents if rate > 0.1% within 1h.
deploy-bot: branch `fix/quickedit-init-race` created, CI started.
Sam: I'll send a PR: change init logic, set rows=[], add telemetry, add FF, add rollout plan (5% 2h -> 50% 4h -> 100%).
Jon: add server-side assertion that rejects requests where `x-org-id` != session org to guard against header flips.
Maya: also add a short-term UI mitigation: show skeleton + neutral placeholder until first fetch completes to avoid leaking previous rows.
Ava: and include a small visual indicator when org param mismatch happens so users know the console is reconciling.
Sam: adding tests: unit for useEffect behavior, integration for race, e2e replay of repro steps.
Priya: pls include changelog entry: "Fix: QuickEdit transiently showing rows from other orgs during rapid org switches."
Ava: can telemetry auto-trigger a rollback? I'd like FF to go to 0% if mismatch rate spikes above threshold.
Sam: yes we can wire an automated rollback via the feature flag controller on that metric. I'll add it to the FF config.
telemetry-bot: noted and will post an incident if threshold hit.
security: looking now, initial read looks like UI-only exposure but agree P2 until confirmed. Can you add the repro video and timestamps?
Ava: will upload video to the PR and paste link here.
Sam: assigning to myself to own the fix until merged. Will tag for review from @Priya and @Jon. :thumbsup:
